name: Bembe 12/8 kit
desc: Afro-Cuban 12/8 bembe: the classic short-bell pattern on cowbell, dotted-pulse kick underneath, tom melody answering across the barline, cross-stick on the second dotted beat; peak widens into a rolling tom conversation.

code.sparse: stack(s("cb ~ cb ~ cb cb ~ cb ~ cb ~ cb").gain(${gain}*.4).hpf(700).pan(.6), s("bd ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ bd ~ ~ ~ ~ ~").gain(${gain}*.7).shape(.2).lpf(900)).mask("<1 1 1 [1 0]>").fast(${rate}).room(${room}).orbit(1).play()
code.full: stack(s("cb ~ cb ~ cb cb ~ cb ~ cb ~ cb").gain(${gain}*.46).hpf(700).pan(.62), s("bd ~ ~ bd ~ ~ bd ~ ~ bd ~ ~").gain("[.8 0 0 .5 0 0 .74 0 0 .5 0 0]").shape(.22).lpf(950), s("~ ~ ~ rim ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ rim ~ ~").gain(${gain}*.4).pan(.42), s("~ lt ~ ~ mt ~ ~ ~ ht ~ mt ~").gain("[0 .34 0 0 .3 0 0 0 .36 0 .28 0]").speed(1.05).shape(.15).pan(sine.range(.35,.65).slow(16))).lastOf(4, x=>x.ply("1 1 1 1 1 2")).fast(${rate}).room(${room}).orbit(1).play()
